resources.string: 7. Text or labels missing?\n- Turn off HideMyApplist (HMA) for Instagram. InstaEclipse reads its text from its own app, which HMA hides.
8. A feature stays off even when enabled?\n- Instagram\'s server config can block it. Use Developer Options, then Restore Default Config.
9. Still stuck?\n- Ask in the Telegram group: t.me/EclipseMods_Discussion
